Execute a capability. Delegates to `capability run`

Usage: sddk run [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>

Options:
      --name <NAME>
          Capability name

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Human-friendly text rendering
          - json: Machine-readable JSON envelope
          
          [default: text]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
